Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner set an incorrect search strategy from the outset by omitting the crucial “stage name” qualifier and the likely entertainment/magician context. Directing WebSurfer to search “Aladin consultant performance improvement” steered the process into irrelevant results about BlackRock’s Aladdin platform and generic consulting firms. This failure to disambiguate “Aladin” (the stage name) from “Aladdin” (the platform) and to include context keywords (e.g., “stage name,” “magician”) caused iterative, unproductive searches and prevented identification of the correct individual, Eenasul Fateh (stage name “Aladin”), who used consulting to help organizations improve performance. Subsequent steps compounded the error, but the first misstep occurred at Step 1.
